facts.fact: The Algerian government reviewed on 17 December 2025 the setting up of two strategic infrastructures forming Algeria's first national cloud, meant to secure and modernise public services by hosting sovereign data.
The Prime Minister's communique describes the two infrastructures of the first national cloud as hosting sovereign data, alongside a second national data centre in service since 26 September 2025.
The government reviewed on 17 December 2025 the project of the national digital services portal Dzair digital services, giving unified web and mobile access to public services.

DZA.note: No count of services or usage stated.

facts.fact: The government reviewed the second national data centre, in service since 26 September 2025, and a first national cloud meant to host the state's sovereign data.

DZA.note: Ownership, for-hire service and Tier are not stated.
